description: Generate a bounded base64-encoded PDF containing publicly verifiable native Circle USDC transaction evidence for an existing on-chain transfer. Use when a customer or accountant needs a downloadable blockchain proof, not when you need a machine-readable exact recipient and amount check (use match_native_usdc_payment) or a simple transaction lookup (use verify_native_usdc). The PDF is not an invoice, tax receipt or authorization. No custody or transfers. Costs 0.05 USDC via x402 v2 on Base or Solana MCP.

network.description: Blockchain inspected; the separate API payment always settles native USDC on Base.

tx_hash.description: Public transaction to inspect: 0x plus 64 hex characters for EVM; base58 64-byte Solana signature. Must match network.
